title: 第5章 三长老力荐曹立第6章 曹立你敢
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
很快，长老的尸体就被长老会的人带走了，而长老的死因，自然不能给曹立等人知道。
“你们先回去吧，长老人选，会由长老会商量之后再去你们执法堂宣布，这段期间，做好你们的本职工作。”长老会的人来宣布后，就回去了。
曹立走出医药堂，太危险了，在这个世界。
执法长老有着结丹初期的修为，比现在的曹立，强了何止百倍，都被人活活打死。
太可怕了，还是要尽快强大起来啊。
曹立摸了摸额头的冷汗。
对了，杨开彬，奖励！
刚才忙着长老的事情，让杨开彬给逃了。
跑得了和尚跑不了庙，想跑，没门。
曹立气势汹汹，只要击败了杨开彬，就能够获得筑基境的修为。
别人突破练气到筑基的门槛，需要天赋，机缘，以及十几二十年的时间，而他，只需要开挂。
“开挂开挂！”
“老大，你嘀咕啥呢？长老怎么样了？”此时，小虎追过来了，一脸关心。
他们修为低，跑得气喘吁吁的。
“长老没了。”曹立用着尽量平淡的语气说道。
“啊？”
小虎们有点错愕，但真的听到这个结果，还是有点不敢相信的，执法长老可是结丹境啊，修为通天。
但旋即一想，小虎就眼睛一亮。
“曹哥，长老如果没了，那这个长老之位，不就空出来了吗？您身为一队队长，岂不是机会最大的人？”
“别胡说，事情还不一定呢。”曹立强按下嘴角的弧度：“好了，那个杨开彬呢？”

“杨开彬，给他逃了！”小虎说道。
“追，犯了宗门律令，天涯海角他都跑不掉。”
曹立喊道：“今天我就是给你们来出头的，大胆的给我干！”
“是！”小虎喊得最大声，刚才两巴掌，他抽得很舒服。
以曹立为首，朝杨开彬的洞府追去。
……
长老会。
执法长老的事情已经商量完毕了，执法长老是因为查看秘境的事情发生意外的。
执法堂有护宗司，兼顾着守护宗门的责任，遇到宗门附近出现秘境，自然要去探查。
之前护宗长老有其他事情，所以才让执法长老去，现在执法长老已经发生意外，只能将护宗长老叫回来，再派其他人结伴一起去看。
能将执法长老逼死的秘境，绝对不简单，不能掉以轻心。
“现在执法长老一位空了出来，可有合适的人选替补上去？”宗主是个中年模样的瘦子，脸很长，下巴续着三十来厘米的黑须，头上戴着金冠，又穿着宽松的道袍，一副仙风道骨的模样。
宗主看向执法堂的其他三司长老。
这是想让他们推荐。
往届都是从执法队队长中挑选，来继任四司长老。
“我提议曹立这个人。”审讯司长老抬手。
content_en:
Soon, the elder's body was taken away by the people of the Presbyterian Church. Naturally, the cause of the elder's death could not be known to Cao Li and others.
"You go back first. The selection of elders will be discussed by the Presbyterian Council before going to your Law Enforcement Hall to announce it. During this period, do your job well." The people from the Presbyterian Council came to make the announcement and then went back.
Cao Li walked out of the medical hall. It was too dangerous in this world.
The law enforcement elder had the cultivation level of the early stage of pill formation, and was more than a hundred times stronger than the current Cao Li, but he was beaten to death.
It's too scary. We still need to become stronger as soon as possible.
Cao Li touched the cold sweat on his forehead.
By the way, Yang Kaibin, reward!
Yang Kaibin was busy with the elder's affairs just now, so he escaped.
A monk who can run away cannot run away from the temple. If he wants to run away, there is no way.
Cao Li is so powerful that as long as he defeats Yang Kaibin, he will be able to obtain the cultivation level of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
For others, it takes talent, opportunity, and ten or twenty years to break through the threshold of Qi training and foundation building, but he only needs cheating.
"Cheating, cheating!"
"Boss, what are you muttering about? How is the elder?" At this time, Xiaohu chased after him with a concerned look on his face.
Their cultivation level was low and they were running out of breath.
"The elder is gone." Cao Li said in as calm a tone as possible.
"Huh?"
The little tigers were a little stunned, but when they heard this result, they still couldn't believe it. The law enforcement elder was in the Danjie realm, and his cultivation level was as high as the sky.
But as soon as he thought about it, Xiaohu's eyes lit up.
"Brother Cao, if the elder is gone, wouldn't the position of the elder be vacant? As the captain of the first team, aren't you the one with the greatest chance?"
"Don't talk nonsense, things are not certain yet." Cao Liqiang lowered the corners of his mouth: "Okay, where is Yang Kaibin?"
"Yang Kaibin, run away for him!" Xiaohu said.
"Chasing has violated the sect's laws. He can't escape even to the ends of the earth."
Cao Li shouted: "I'm here to show off for you today, so be bold and do it for me!"
"Yes!" Xiaohu shouted the loudest. The two slaps just now were very comfortable for him.
Led by Cao Li, they pursued Yang Kaibin's cave.
…
Presbyterian Church.
The matter of the law enforcement elders has been discussed. The law enforcement elders had an accident while inspecting the secret realm.
The Law Enforcement Hall has a Protector of the Sect, who also has the responsibility of guarding the sect. When a secret realm appears near the sect, it is natural to investigate it.
The elder who protected the sect had other matters before, so he asked the elder of law enforcement to go. Now that the elder of law enforcement has had an accident, he can only call the elder of sect protector back and send others to watch together.
The secret realm that can drive the law enforcement elders to death is definitely not simple and should not be taken lightly.
"Now that the law enforcement elder is vacant, is there a suitable candidate to replace him?" The sect leader is a thin, middle-aged man with a long face and a thirty-centimeter black beard on his chin. He wears a golden crown on his head and a loose Taoist robe. He looks like an immortal.
The sect leader looked at the other three elders of the Law Enforcement Hall.
This is to make them recommend.
In previous years, they were selected from among the captains of the law enforcement team to succeed the elders of the Fourth Division.
"I propose that Cao Li be established." The interrogation director raised his hand.
